legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.content:
1. Data Controller

The data controller within the meaning of the GDPR is the operator of this Klacks instance. Please refer to the Legal Notice for the controller's contact details.

2. Data Collected and Processed

2.1 User Account

A user account is required to use the application. The following data is processed: email address, password (as a cryptographic hash), first and last name, and the assigned user role. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract).

2.2 Employee and Client Data

For workforce planning, the following data is processed: name, address, contact details (email, phone), date of birth, gender, profile picture, and GPS coordinates of the address. Contact data is stored encrypted in the database. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract) or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in workforce scheduling).

2.3 Schedules and Absences

Working time data, shift assignments, breaks, expenses, and absences are processed for workforce planning purposes. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.

3. Data Transfers to Third Parties

Depending on the instance configuration, the following external services may be used:

ServicePurposeData TransferredProvider
OpenStreetMapMap displayIP address, map viewportOpenStreetMap Foundation, UK
NominatimAddress geocodingAddress dataOpenStreetMap Foundation, UK
OpenRouteServiceRoute optimizationGPS coordinates (anonymized)HeiGIT gGmbH, Germany
DeepLText translationTexts to be translatedDeepL SE, Germany
AI AssistantChatbot functionalityChat history, planning dataDepending on configuration (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek)
LDAP / OAuth2AuthenticationLogin credentialsDepending on configuration
SMTP / IMAPEmail sending and receivingEmail content, sender, recipientDepending on configuration

These services are used on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in application functionality). Services that are not configured will not be contacted.

4. Browser Storage

The application uses browser storage (LocalStorage) for the following purposes:

  • Authentication: JWT token, refresh token, and token expiry to maintain the session
  • User preferences: Language selection and UI preferences (e.g. column widths)

No third-party tracking cookies or analytics tools are used.

5. Data Storage and Deletion

All data is stored in a PostgreSQL database managed by the operator of this instance.

When records are deleted, a soft-delete marker is initially set. After the configured retention period expires, the data is automatically and irrevocably physically deleted. The retention period can be set by the administrator in the settings.

6. Data Security

Communication between browser and server is exclusively via HTTPS (TLS encryption). Passwords are stored only as cryptographic hashes. Contact data (email, phone) is stored encrypted in the database. Real-time communication (WebSocket/SignalR) is also secured by JWT token authentication.

7. Your Rights

Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

  • Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR): You may request information about your stored personal data.
  • Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): You may request the correction of inaccurate data.
  • Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): You may request the deletion of your data, provided no legal retention obligations apply.
  • Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
  • Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
  • Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR): You may object to the processing of your data.
  • Right to lodge a complaint: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.

To exercise your rights, please contact the controller listed in the Legal Notice.

8. Changes

This privacy policy may be updated by the operator at any time. The current version is always available on this page.
